notes.title: Patch Notes: September 21st 2024
notes.content:
- Keyboard and controller layout diagram in options menu.
- Improved collisions on Mayor’s Island.
- Reworked Prison of Toya.
- General Performance Improvements.

notes.title: Patch Notes: September 2nd 2024
notes.content:
- Character Control: Improved character control with faster deceleration when running.
- Lightning Transition: Extended the duration of the lightning transition for a smoother experience.
- Mosey Fix: Mosey no longer appears after taking the cat.
- Stuck Prevention: Blocked areas where players could previously get stuck.
- Cliff Climbing: Made it easier to climb the cliff to reach Tiiobi’s cat.
- Delivery Quests: Added a check to ensure you have a leash before starting delivery quests.
- Quest Marker: Quest markers are now visible from the beginning of play without opening journal.
- Leash Mechanic: Removed the shooting leash mechanic.
- Bow Availability: If the bow wasn’t picked up earlier, it will now appear during the Cloud Chaser quest.

notes.title: Patch Notes: August 30th 2024
notes.content:
- Log Tutorial: Player hits logs now properly blocked, and the RT/click widget is displayed on the log.
- Cassette Labelling: Fixed issue where cassettes were not labeled as music.
- Camera Tutorial: Now responds to Press F/LB Tutorial
- Cat Spawning: Fixed issue where holding a cat would incorrectly spawn another cat.
- Gliding Tutorial: WASD gliding intro no longer requires pressing 'A'; instead, the tutorial box closes with a press forward.
- Tutorial Box Navigation: Updated to use 'Press A/Space' to move the tutorial box down.
- First Jump: Added a plank to assist with the first jump.
- Sprint Tutorial: Increased the distance required in the sprint tutorial before the dash tutorial.
- Rabbit House Collision: Improved collision detection around the rabbit house.
- Mosey Behaviour: Fixed issue where Mosey would still appear after Mosey should be gone.
- Mosey Widget: Added a widget for Mosey when he is far away.
- Quest Journal: Resolved issue where the quest journal could not be opened at times.

notes.title: Patch Notes: August 27th 2024
notes.content:
- Quality Settings: Save and load functionality added for quality settings.
- Mosey Update: Mosey will now reappear when called after reloading before you lose him. 
- Tiiobi's Cat Box: Mosey & box will no longer disappear if picked up with Tiiobi’s cat box.
- Turnip Man Fix: Turnip Man will no longer block the camera during interactions.
- Location Marker Fix: The marker from the rabbit kid’s cat box to the quest giver is now visible.
- Crafting Table: Added an exit button to the crafting table interface.
- First Jump: Has a safety rock to prevent you from falling in water.
- Intro Lake: Easier to traverse in and out of water.
- Gluppie Mount: Fixed issue where the press 'Y' to mount Gluppie info message wouldn’t always display.
- Options Menu: Simplified to only having Low, Medium, High.
- General Performance Improvements.

notes.title: Patch Notes: August 25th 2024
notes.content:
- Alchemist Chest: Added close button functionality for keyboard to prevent getting stuck.
- Slingshot Update: Increased sphere collision size for better slingshot accuracy.
- Yard Sale Widget: Improved widget behaviour for more predictable functionality.
- Purple Honey Intro: Disabled physics simulation during overlap in the Purple Honey intro sequence.
- Time Dilation Fix: Time dilation now resets to 1 after exiting the skills menu.
- Treehouse Fix: Resolved issue where players could get stuck under the Rabbit treehouse.
- Petting Cat: Removed bug where character mesh disappears sometimes.
- Skill Menu Update: Double-checked to ensure the mouse is visible when in the skill menu.
- Mouse Sensitivity: Mouse sensitivity is now saved between sessions.
- Sensitivity Tuning: Reduced mouse sensitivity at the start of the game.
- Intro Flying Tutorial: Increased size for collision boxes.
- Camera Switching: Removed delay removing camera switching in intro scene. 
- Kazerne Chest: Fixed issue where the chest in Kazerne was not functioning properly.

notes.title: Patch Notes: August 24th 2024
notes.content:
* Cloud Chaser Update: Moved the marker for Cloud Chaser back to the Rabbit.
* New Set Released: Purple Honey set has dropped!
* Character Movement Improvements: Enhanced movement for smoother gameplay.
* Flower Interaction: Press 'E' to interact with flowers near the Rabbit.
* Bandana: Removed crazy physics.
* House Navigation: Players can no longer enter the downstairs area of the house.
* Lock-On System: Improved lock-on for characters during quest objectives.
* Mosey Navigation Update: Better navigation pathing for Mosey.
* Map Clipping Fix: Resolved issue where players could clip through the map when locking onto a crow.
* Save System Update: Players' character saves automatically after completing the first farmer quest to prevent broken saves upon dying. Journal also now saves properly.
* Marker Removal: The quest marker no longer redirects to a quest that has already been completed.
* Treehouse Collision Fix: Improved collision detection for the treehouse to prevent players from getting stuck.
* Control Adjustments: Fixed floaty controls for a more responsive experience.
* Skill Limit Fix: Players are now not limited to changing only 3 skills.
* Grass Fix: Resolved issue with floating grass in certain areas.
* Camera Intro: Removed camera component when pressing radio buttons.
